chunks: Munthir ibn Jayfar narrated from Yahya ibn Talhah al-Nahdi, who said:
Abu Abdullah عليه السلام said to us: "Travel and slip away quietly, for it is easier for you."

key_terms.أَخَفُّ: Lighter or easier in burden and difficulty.
key_terms.عَلَيْكُمْ: For you; upon you in terms of ease or hardship.
key_terms.وَانْسَلُّوا: Move off quietly or slip away discreetly.

ai.seo_question: What did Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام advise about traveling in a discreet and easier manner?
ai.summary: This hadith conveys practical guidance from Imam Abu Abdullah عليه السلام about conduct during travel. It recommends moving in a discreet and light manner, indicating an ethic of ease, prudence, and orderly conduct on the road.

en.bab-ul-qaim-publications: Hadith.2501 - Munthir ibn Ja‘far narrated from Yahya ibn Talhah al-Nahdi, who said that Imam Abu Abdullah (as) said to us:
"Travel in small groups and slip away quietly; it will be easier for you."
